about: planTransfer on the receiver's stored values (`storage`) and a decoded code (`incoming`): the plan (additions, resets, keptLocal, settings, warnings, empty, writes; `before` is `storage` and is omitted) and the storage after its writes. Units are (date, period), (date, sura) and (date, phrase key); the later reset epoch takes a unit whole, equal epochs join (max, OR, earliest instant).

the union completes a period: completedAt is the merge instant
the sender reset later: the receiver's stale counts are replaced (resets row with before/after)

history days deleted on the sender (tombstones) are deleted here

a card reset makes the whole period the later side's (limitation: the other side's other cards go)
suwar: pages OR; a sura reset wins for that sura only
tasbih: a phrase reset wins for that phrase only; other phrases take the max

cases.name: settings: imported only where absent here and not the default; reminder switches, lastShown and location never
receiver-owned: targets (absent keys filled), selected sura and phrase, tasbih target; phrases matched by spelling
a code from yesterday: its today arrives as yesterday's history (stale warning)
a code from a device whose date is ahead: its today and today's history are ignored (future warning)
history is kept by date for the 31-day window, not by count: a full week and two older days are all kept
days before this receiver's 31-day window are not added (trimmed warning)
reset epochs only (adhkar): nothing visible changes, but the plan is not empty (hidden.resets) and writes the epoch
reset epochs only (suwar): hidden.resets, written
reset epochs only (tasbih): hidden.resets, written
after the epochs arrived, the code from before the reset changes nothing (keptLocal; empty)
equivalent unsaved spellings are one unit: max, never the sum
a saved spelling arriving later names the unit; its count is not added to the orphan's
a reset of one spelling resets the equivalent unit
equivalent keys on one side with different epochs reduce as (epoch, count): the later reset takes the unit (2, not 10), today and in history
the same from a store whose saved spelling the app's load would sum: the transfer reduces, never sums (2, not 12)
an alias holding only a newer reset takes part with count 0: the unit is reset, today and in history
nothing new: an empty plan
reset epochs before the 31-day window are dropped
a backup file: adhkar and settings only (backup warning)
a reset epoch years ahead of this clock: refused before planning (clock), storage untouched
a completion instant more than a day ahead of this clock: refused (clock)
exportedAt before 2020: refused (clock)
a reset epoch less than a day ahead of this clock (skew between devices): accepted
adhkar item IDs this version does not have are dropped before merging (progress and targets)
the merged tasbih day would hold more than 256 phrase keys: refused whole (too-big), existing counts untouched
the merged tasbih store would hold more than 512 phrase keys in all: refused (too-big)
